The '''Imperial Heavy Trooper''' was a variant of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]].

==Overview==
These soldiers were large warriors that wore a specialized type of stormtrooper armor and were trained for frontline combat against incredibly powerful enemies such as [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], and other large aliens.

They were rare but were almost always found at the front of a vanguard where they provided protection for standard stormtroopers and other ranged weapon specialists.

==Equipment==
===Gear===
Due to their role in melee based combat, these troopers made use of large [[Electrostaff/Legends|electro staffs]] against their enemies. The weapons allowed them to stun their foes with medium-range electrical arcs, and were quite capable of killing even a [[The Force/Legends|Force]] user in close combat.

===Armor===
Their armor provided them a limited level of protection against a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Their armor resembled that of the [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]], albeit slightly darker in color. Most heavy troopers were also issued backpacks.

==History==
Numerous heavy troopers were deployed on the Wookiee homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] where were engaged by a [[Galen Marek|mysterious Force user]]. Individual heavy troopers were later engaged by the same person on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] at the [[Imperial Ore Facility]], and on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

Despite being encased in reinforced armor and equipped with [[Electrostaff/Legends|electro staffs]], the heavy troopers could not withstand Galen Marek's Force powers, and were unable to hinder him on any of his missions.

==Behind the scenes==
The title of "heavy stormtrooper" comes from [[Hasbro]] toy catalogues.

Heavy stormtroopers have alternately been seen with yellow paint decoration on their arms and legs.
